says: An optional `plugin.json` manifest can override paths or add metadata; without one, Grok discovers components from these standard directories.
Plugins are off by default, so list one in `enabled` to turn it on
`GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT` | Absolute path to the plugin's installed directory.
Only an explicit `deny` decision returned by the hook blocks a tool call.
All hook failures (timeouts, crashes, malformed output, missing required env vars) are fail-open
